verdict.rationale: Polar documents hosted, embedded, and API-driven checkout surfaces, so a payment-methods question fairly applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL, or any local payment method. A generic 'embedded payment-method view' and Stripe test cards do not show that wallets or local methods are offered.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
